newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Kuantan Flour says proposed deal aborted.
newsitem.headline: Kuantan Flour says proposed deal aborted.

text.p: Malaysia's Kuantan Flour Mills Bhd said that a proposed transaction involving it has been cancelled, and asked for its stock to be requoted.
The flour milling and trading company made the statement late on Friday to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
In a brief letter, it said, "The request (for a stock suspension) was made due to a proposed transaction involving the company. The negotiations have been aborted." The company gave no details.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment. Shares of Kuantan Flour closed at 8.10 ringgit on November 15.
